# Flat White Living

> Interior design and project management studio based in The Hague, the Netherlands, run by Elisa Vives. Works throughout the Netherlands and internationally, with a focus on international clients.

## Pages
- [Interior Designer in The Hague & the Netherlands](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/): Bespoke interior design, architecture, project management and styling for homes and international clients in the Netherlands. Based in The Hague.
- [About](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/about.html): Meet the designer behind Flat White Living, an interior design studio in The Hague working with international clients across the Netherlands.
- [Contact](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/contact.html): Start your interior design project. Get in touch with Flat White Living in The Hague.
- [How It Works](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/how-it-works.html): From the first brief and design concept to sourcing, installation and final styling: how an interior design project with Flat White Living works.
- [Interior Design for International Clients in the Netherlands](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/international-clients.html): One point of contact for expats and international clients: suppliers, contractors and decisions handled locally in the Netherlands.
- [Journal](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/journal.html): Notes on interiors, materials and living well in Dutch homes, from Flat White Living in The Hague.
- [Interior Design Projects](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/projects.html): Selected residential and commercial interior design projects in The Hague, Wassenaar, Scheveningen, Rotterdam and Valencia.
- [Interior Design Services](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/services.html): Interior design, architecture, project management, styling and property staging in The Hague and throughout the Netherlands.

## Projects
- [A City Apartment in Valencia](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-city-apartment-valencia.html): Remote interior design and project management of a pre-war city apartment in Valencia, Spain.
- [A Coastal Family House in Scheveningen](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-coastal-family-house-scheveningen.html): Interior design of a year-round family house near the sea in Scheveningen, built to live with sand, salt and bicycles.
- [A Flat in the City Centre of Rotterdam](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-flat-rotterdam-city-centre.html): Interior design of a compact city-centre flat in Rotterdam with continuous joinery and a calm, restrained palette.
- [A Neighbourhood Coffee Bar in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-neighbourhood-coffee-bar-the-hague.html): Commercial interior design of a neighbourhood coffee bar in The Hague: counter layout, service flow and warm materials.
- [A Refined Family Home in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-refined-family-home-the-hague.html): Interior design of a refined family home in The Hague: marble, oak and hexagonal mosaic across kitchen and bathrooms.
- [A Restored City Apartment in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-restored-city-apartment-the-hague.html): Restoration of a listed first-floor apartment in The Hague, recovering the original enfilade and period details.
- [A Townhouse Renovation in The Hague](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-townhouse-renovation-the-hague.html): Renovation of a period townhouse in The Hague: blue panelling, bespoke wardrobes and brass details alongside original mouldings.
- [A Villa by the Dunes in Wassenaar](https://www.flatwhiteliving.com/project-villa-by-the-dunes-wassenaar.html): Interior design of a light-filled family villa by the dunes in Wassenaar: pale oak, lime plaster and bronze.
